import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.Adjunction
import CategoryTheory.PresheafOfModules

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] (R : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ RingCat) (X : Cᵒᵖ) :
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfSize.{v, v, max u₁ v, v, max (max (max u u₁) (v + 1)) v₁, max u (v + 1)}
  (PresheafOfModules.evaluation R X) := by
  let F := PresheafOfModules.evaluation R X
  let G := PresheafOfModules.tensor R X
  let adj : F ⊣ G :=
    { unit := by
        intro A
        apply NatTrans.id
        intro a
        exact isIso.id
      counit := by
        intro A
        apply NatTrans.id
        intro a
        exact isIso.id
      triangle_one := by
        intro A
        apply NatTrans.id
        intro a
        exact isIso.id
      triangle_two := by
        intro A
        apply NatTrans.id
        intro a
        exact isIso.id }
  have : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfSize (F) :=
    Limits.preserves_limits_of_right_adjoint F adj
